services.title: Titanium Dental Implant Surgery
services.description: Restore missing teeth with premium titanium dental implants that fuse naturally with jawbone for lifetime stability and authentic chewing power.
services.idealFor: Missing single or multiple teeth, loose denture replacement

services.title: Gentle Tooth Extractions
services.description: Careful sectional extraction of severely damaged or painful teeth with micro-instruments to protect surrounding bone and ensure fast healing.
services.idealFor: Severely decayed teeth, impacted roots, orthodontic clearance

services.title: Ultrasonic Scaling & Teeth Polishing
services.description: Advanced ultrasonic plaque and tartar removal from deep gum pockets followed by micro-polishing for smooth enamel and fresh breath.
services.idealFor: Plaque accumulation, bad breath, bleeding gums, routine checkup

services.title: Zirconia & Ceramic Dental Crowns
services.description: Precision milled zirconia and ceramic crowns designed to seamlessly cover fractured teeth and bridge gaps with natural tooth translucency.
services.idealFor: Cracked teeth, post-RCT tooth reinforcement, missing tooth gaps

services.title: Custom Precision Dentures
services.description: Custom-molded full and partial acrylic dentures engineered for suction stability and facial support to make dining and smiling effortless.
services.idealFor: Multiple missing teeth, older denture replacement

services.title: Rotary Root Canal Therapy
services.description: Modern rotary root canal treatment to eradicate deep tooth infection and relieve acute pain while preserving your authentic natural tooth root.
services.idealFor: Severe toothache, deep decay, heat/cold sensitivity
